title: Security and Fire Alarm Systems Installers
description: Install, program, maintain, and repair security and fire alarm wiring and equipment. Ensure that work is in accordance with relevant codes.

tasks.text: Install, maintain, or repair security systems, alarm devices, or related equipment, following blueprints of electrical layouts and building plans.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical component-level repair work

dwas.name: Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.
Repair electrical components.

tasks.text: Mount and fasten control panels, door and window contacts, sensors, or video cameras, and attach electrical and telephone wiring to connect components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical installation is hands-on licensed trade work

dwas.name: Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.
Position equipment using hand tools, power tools, or heavy equipment.

tasks.text: Demonstrate systems for customers and explain details, such as the causes and consequences of false alarms.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — AI can script; live explanation and trust are human

dwas.name: Explain use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Test and repair circuits and sensors, following wiring and system specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.
Repair electrical circuits or wiring.

tasks.text: Feed cables through access holes, roof spaces, or cavity walls to reach fixture outlets, positioning and terminating cables, wires, or strapping.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying cables requires physical routing work

dwas.name: Lay cables to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Examine systems to locate problems, such as loose connections or broken insulation.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating electrical faults requires hands-on inspection

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to locate or identify electrical problems.

tasks.text: Test backup batteries, keypad programming, sirens, or other security features to ensure proper functioning or to diagnose malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical safety-equipment checks need hands-on presence

dwas.name: Inspect safety equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Drill holes for wiring in wall studs, joists, ceilings, or floors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Inspect installation sites and study work orders, building plans, and installation manuals to determine materials requirements and installation procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Procedure drafting aided; context-specific validation human

dwas.name: Determine types of equipment, tools, or materials needed for jobs.
Plan work procedures.

tasks.text: Consult with clients to assess risks and to determine security requirements.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Assessing customer problems needs live diagnostic dialogue

dwas.name: Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Mount raceways and conduits and fasten wires to wood framing, using staplers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Running wiring is hands-on installation

dwas.name: Run wiring to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Adjust sensitivity of units, based on room structures and manufacturers' recommendations, using programming keypads.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Keep informed of new products and developments.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes developments; human retains expertise

dwas.name: Maintain knowledge of current developments in area of expertise.

tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Prepare documents, such as invoices or warranties.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document routine operational activities from inputs

dwas.name: Document operational activities.

tasks.text: Provide customers with cost estimates for equipment installation.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Labor/material cost estimation from rates

dwas.name: Estimate costs for labor or materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information
